product_metadata.title: Hygge Hush Queen Bamboo Mattress Protector, Cooling and Waterproof Mattress Cover with Deep Pocket (up to 21”), Breathable Noiseless Ultra Soft Mattress Pad Cover for Bedding (Queen, 60"x80")
features: Cooling & Soft: It is made of 40% viscose from bamboo and 60% polyester, distributing heat evenly and help regulate body temperature to provide a comfortable sense all night. You will feel cooling but not cold and soft when you lie on the bed protector.

100% Waterproof: The bottom of this mattress cover is lined with the latest waterproof TPU membrane layer. It prevents liquid from penetrating into the mattress, keeping the mattress dry and clean, ensuring your sleep quality.

Elastic Deep Pocket: Smooth but non-slip backing with stretchy skirt up to 21”, this deep pocket completely covers the mattress from the top and sides. The 360-degree elastic band not only fits the mattress well and keeps it in the right place, but also conveniently to put on or off.

7 Sizes for you: Hygge Hush mattress protector has 7 sizes for you to choose from. Crib: 28"x52"x9"; Twin: 39"x75"x15"; Twin XL: 39"x80"x15"; Full: 54"x75"x15"; Queen: 60"x80"x15"; King: 78"x80"x15"; California King: 72"X84"X15".
Easy Care: Machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle. Do not bleach, tumble dry low and natural drying.
